name: gradient-mesh
title: Gradient Mesh
description: A soft, slowly shifting field of colour for a hero or a feature band. A few large blurred glows, each a theme colour, drift on long loops over a base surface, so the band feels alive without anything a reader has to watch. Content goes in `children` and…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/gradient-mesh

Installed to `components/ui/effects/gradient-mesh.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/gradient-mesh';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/gradient-mesh

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
